item.title: Sport Ireland Launches First-Ever Sport Ireland National Disability In Sport Week 2025
item.description: Sport Ireland has launched the first-ever Sport Ireland Disability in Sport Week to showcase the contributions of people with disabilities who participate, coach, officiate, volunteer, and lead in sport.
